digest.component_or_area: binding store and GET rotation sidecar
propositions: Introduce a new rotation module that owns fail-open sidecar load/save with max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) semantics for each Jira key.
Dual-write every new timestamp stamp to both .bridge_state/get_rotation.json sidecar and legacy inline field during rollout compatibility window.
Persist sidecar only through BindingStore.save() paths covering end-of-pass, write-ahead, recovery, and retirement saves, without creating sidecar during reconcile-check.
An interleaved sequence of old-binary and new-binary passes produces identical rotation order as all-new-binary sequence when dual-writes are correct.
Extract outbound wrappers to keep outbound_differ.py at or below 800-line cap while wiring BindingStore and outbound_differ to shared rotation accessors.
Stage and commit both dual-written rotation files in one local binding-store commit without git add -A.
